_comment: Repository guard settings (scripts/guard.mjs). Keep every list short and specific: an entry here weakens a check.
addressCheckExemptWhy: third-party address lists (scam database, OFAC SDN) refreshed by scripts/update-blacklist.mjs and scripts/update-sanctions.mjs; the hashed denylist still covers them
spdxExemptWhy: generated, minified browser bundles (their sources carry the headers)
